capabilities: Repair LaTeX math formatting on paste
Review ambiguous formula repairs before inserting
Repair formulas in a selection or the whole note
Convert pasted rich HTML into Markdown
Export notes to Word, WeChat or Markdown through a companion web app
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown formatter or linter; it repairs LaTeX math in pasted content.
extras: Companion web app (Vite) handles preview, formula review and Word/WeChat/Markdown export; all conversion runs locally. Recovering formulas from pasted HTML needs LaTeX annotations or data-latex/data-tex attributes, and complex embeds and attachment folders have limited support.
problem: LaTeX pasted from other apps arrives with broken delimiters and parentheses, so every formula has to be cleaned up by hand.
summary: Obsidian plugin that repairs LaTeX math formatting when pasting and lets you review ambiguous formula repairs before inserting them.
